{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE HARDENED UPTO 32-35 HRC. 2) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 3) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field is '---' while note N2 specifies hardening to 32-35 HRC with threads kept soft, but neither defines the stage at which the treatment applies (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding). This ambiguity can cause the machinist to apply hardness at the wrong manufacturing step, risking distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened stock. The designer should fill in the heat_treatment field and add the required processing stage to note N2."
  , "recommended_correction": "Update the heat_treatment title block field and note N2 to specify the manufacturing stage for the 32-35 HRC hardening (e.g., 'after rough machining, before finish grinding')."}]}
